notes.title: Patch Notes v.0.79.0
notes.content: [h1][b]v.0.79.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Patch Summary[/h2][p][/p][p]This patch adds the ability for players to re-draw cards in their starting hand, adds a number of new cards, removes the concept of maximum HP for entities, tweaks the difficulty curve as well as adds some visual updates and bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Overview[/h2][p][/p][h3]Mulligan[/h3][p]This patch adds the ability for players (and of course the AI) to re-draw cards in their starting hand at the beginning of the battle. There has been some player frustration with the starting hand as it can be a very important factor in the way that the early battles play out, much more so than in StS-style card games where the hand is re-shuffled every turn.[/p][p]This change should give players more control in the strategy at the start of the battle and allow them a chance to get more ship defenses up if they wish to do so. The selected cards are shuffled in the back of the deck and are replaced with new cards from the top of the deck. If the player deck is 4 cards or less, this stage doesn't happen.[/p][p][/p][h3]Maximum HP Removal[/h3][p]Up until this patch, units and mounts had a maximum HP, which was defined by their card, so all HP gain actions were limited by this maximum HP. Some cards and actions changed the maximum HP and also healed by that amount, making for long and somewhat confusing wording. This patch simplifies all HP increase interactions by removing the concept of maximum HP and letting any HP gain to happen infinitely, regardless of the original HP specified on the card.[/p][p]HP display on the map will now be colored green if it's above the original HP or red if it's below it. This same visual language is also added to damage and power number displays on the map.[/p][p][/p][h3]Further difficulty curve changes[/h3][p]The difficulty curve got some more tweaks and some new low level ships were added to increase ship variety at the beginning of the single player run.[/p][p][/p][h2]Detailed Change List[/h2][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Added a mulligan stage at the start of each battle, allowing players to re-draw cards in their starting hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the concept of max HP for entities. HP can now increase infinitely.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked difficulty curves, added more variety to low level ships.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cards, Ships and Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Added cards: Gunner, Cybermage, Portable Catapult, Thermal Scan, Voidling, Medevac, Barrage, Shield Dust Collector.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ships: Minicube, Cargo Pod, Orca, Trawler[/p][/*][*][p]Crystal Growth now spawns a new Cyrstal Growth instead of cloning itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Breach now costs 2 power.[/p][/*][*][p]Recall now costs 1 power.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto Turret is now 2/1.[/p][/*][*][p]Bioweapon now 1 move range.[/p][/*][*][p]Incinerate now does 2 damage instead of 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Medbot now heals all adjacent friendly units.[/p][/*][*][p]Medpack now fully heals unit up to its original HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Heaven Beam now has a 2 turn charge.[/p][/*][*][p]Remote Control no longer fragile.[/p][/*][*][p]Plasmoid Worshiper now 1 move range.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Graphics and Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new ship skin for low level ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Mounts with 0 power requirement now do not show their power requirement on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Entity HP, damage and power displays on the map now colored green or red depending on whether they are above or below the original value.[/p][/*][*][p]Rollover card preview now shows the original damage, power and HP values.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed enemy decks in singleplayer run being generated with 0 cards in certain cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI getting stuck in an infinite loop while thinking in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed path to the final exit node on the overworld bypassing the final boss fight in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy AI shooting taken over shipmounts inside their own ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare crash on battle victory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mining Laser description not showing updated damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v.0.78.0
notes.content: [h1]v.0.78.0[/h1][p][/p][h2]Patch Overview[/h2][p][/p][h3]Summary[/h3][p][/p][p]This patch addresses difficulty issues in the Singleplayer Run, visual readability issues and card balance and adds a change to the unit movement system and some tutorial updates.[/p][p][/p][h3]Reduced glare and readability improvements.[/h3][p]To address visual readability issues reported by some players, a Glare setting was added to the graphics settings defaulting to a "Low" setting. If you wish, you can now turn off Glare entirely or if you liked the original glow, you can set it back to "High". Some battle UI, background and text colors were also adjusted for better readability.[/p][p][/p][h3]Difficulty reduction.[/h3][p]The difficulty was tweaked across all difficulty modes with Normal difficulty receiving the most changes. The opponent AI skill on Normal was reduced and the difficulty curve of the singleplayer run was adjusted to be quite a bit easier.[/p][p]The ability to spend money to repair the ship after every battle was also added to Normal. This is a feature that used to be present in all difficulty modes, but was moved to Easy difficulty only. This made Normal difficulty unnecessarily difficult for new players and it should be a much more welcoming experience now that it's back in Normal mode. If you wish to experience the challenge of not being able to repair your ship after battle, it is still disabled on Hard mode.[/p][p]A number of cards were balanced to be more fair, especially in the first sector of the singleplayer run.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes to the movement system[/h3][p]The unit movement system was changed to allow for units to move after attacking. Instead of units having 2 action points and losing them after attacking, units now have 1 action point they can use for an attack or movement and a second dedicated movement point they can use for an additional movement before or after an attack or to move twice per turn. This change allows for easier ship boarding and is easier to teach to new players.[/p][p][/p][h2]Detailed Change List[/h2][p][/p][h3]Graphics and Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Added a glare setting to graphics options defaulting to "low" and with an option to turn it off.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some map UI elements and colors of unit and mount stats for better contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some ship tiles for better contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated game backgrounds for better contrast with ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Shields are now colored after the unit's team to prevent confusion.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Tweaked difficulty curve across all difficulty settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal difficulty now allows to repair after each battle like in Easy mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal difficulty AI is now slightly less intelligent.[/p][/*][*][p]Units now have a dedicated second movement point allowing units to move after attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial updated with some more details and opponent deck is made easier.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cards and Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Grenade now does 2 damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Bounty Hunter is now 1 DP, 3 CP and special changed to "Add targeted to the untargeted unit or mount with highest HP on the ship when played."[/p][/*][*][p]Federation SpecOp now does 2 damage and is now a Rare card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fragile Android now 1 movement range and 3 CP.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced price of Mentat.[/p][/*][*][p]Thorn Shot now has a 2 turn charge.[/p][/*][*][p]Time Warp now affects everything on ship.[/p][/*][*][p]Void Saboteur no longer Infiltrator and HP increased to 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Armor Plating now Basic rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Armor Shard now Magnetic.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Crystal Growth cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Energe Bubble HP reduced to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Federation Cop playing its special animation before every shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Laser Cannon cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Mecha Crab cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Modular Bot move range is now 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Orbital Lowlife move range is now 1 and Common rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Robot Factory now requires 4 power.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Targeting Computer cost and made it Common rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Robot Factory Boss: removed weapon and reduced max ship energy.[/p][/*][*][p]Hypnotentacle is now 3/3.[/p][/*][/list]
